title: Risks: hallucination, data leakage and prompt injection

videos.script: A model's words become actions the moment your code uses them. This lesson is about what goes wrong then, and what stops it. A package suggested with confidence, last released in 2011, for Python 2.2. You look it up before anyone installs it. {{packages}} A card number and a CPF sent to a provider for no reason. You take them out first. A log that quietly keeps every customer's email. You keep the numbers, not the words. {{data}} Then an email with an instruction inside it, and a refund of a thousand on an order of ninety-four. {{injection}} The fix is not a firmer prompt. It is a host that offers fewer tools, checks what a draft promises, and asks a person. {{defences}} Every mistake in this lesson is the model's own, made on a computer like yours. Every defence is code you can read.
